Intro: This place is quite gloomy. This could be a Spoilage hotspot, if not treated *personally* by yours truly.
Worry not, I am Doctor Octavian. I have studied this disease longer than you could imagine.
Use these happy pills I developed in your food, they will help combat the negativity which causes Spoilage.
No? Why not? Preposterous, I am a doctor. Who else would you trust with medicine but me? There are no side effects…except maybe for hallucinations.
Success: This dish…could it be a cure to the Spoilage? I feel…satisfied. Yes, satisfied. What did you lace this with?
Fail: Wrong, wrong, wrong! It's all so horrible. Are you trying to make people spoil? You should have just used my pills instead.
Reject: You dare to diagnose me with Spoilage? A modern doctor full of medical knowledge? Let's see who Svetka will trust when I declare *you* to be the spoiled one. She will certainly listen to me!
